ITEM 1 | Cubes of pale off-white firm block, matte surface with slightly soft edges, roughly 2-2.5 cm cubes, about 7 pieces clustered on the left side of the plate, no browning or sheen | 110
ITEM 2 | Fresh dark green leafy greens with thin pale stems, some wilted, plus a few small florets of darker green, sitting in a loose mound in the upper center of the plate, slightly glossy with moisture | 45
ITEM 3 | Thin slices of red-purple onion pieces mixed among the greens, soft and translucent-edged, small amount | 8
ITEM 4 | Wedge-shaped chunks of roasted potato, golden-tan exterior with darker browned edges and a light dusting of herbs, about 3-4 cm pieces, three to four pieces on the upper right, firm and dry-looking | 130
ITEM 5 | Single rectangular slice of baked cheese-topped flatbread, golden-orange with bubbly melted cheese and browned spots, reddish tomato-sauce layer visible beneath, slightly oily sheen, lower center of plate, about 9 x 7 cm and roughly 1 cm thick | 150
ITEM 6 | Small scattered crumbs and specks of dark herb or seasoning on the plate surface, dry and sparse | 2
